t: An MIT middle school curriculum on creating art and music with generative AI.
steps: Find the project page for the MIT Creative AI curriculum.
Read the description of the Creativity and AI workshop.
Ask the project team how to get the materials. No download is linked.
Review the CC BY-NC license terms.
Choose a few plugged and unplugged activities.
Check which tools students will use and whether they need accounts.
Ask IT to test the tools.
